items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CONTROLS (observed): WASD move; arrow keys fire/aim/set facing; movement+fire combine in one step; tears auto-fire in facing direction. E places/uses bomb. Space activates pedestal/item. Q uses/drops held card (no visible effect seen; may throw/drop). Waiting delays. Fine movement: 0.1s≈40px, 0.2s≈80px, 0.5s≈200px. Door/hatch/trapdoor transitions usually need centered overlap plus 2-3 presses; partial overlap often fails, and standing inside the door alcove then pressing again seemed to help. Player sprite renders inconsistently (yellow/pink/white blob, TV-head, gray-face) and can look like enemies; confirm identity by moving.

HUD/PICKUPS (observed): hearts (hollow after damage; blue/soul heart from blue pill), coins, keys, bombs, item/card slots, minimap. Pickups on touch, but coins need exact overlap. Blue pill gave a blue heart, not a key. Red pill suspected heal+blue heart (older, uncertain). Poop can hide/release items (TECH X banner around broken poop); some poop inert. Chests: contact may open but can damage once; loot varies (coins, heart+pill); some chests vanish or act mimic-like. Bombs: bomb-bug explosion dropped a bomb; purchased bomb detonated but ring rocks stayed intact. Rock rings resisted TECH X and one bomb; ring-chest access unresolved. Bomb-bugs explode on contact and chain TNT barrels; avoid.

TECH X (observed): radial ring tear with red X impact; blast radius ~140-150px, center ~170-200px ahead, but placement inconsistent (short sometimes; near walls/obstacles blast appears at feet). Rocks block the line; point-blank is a blind/unsafe spot. Damages fat, gray faces, shelled, flies, grouped spiders. Does NOT crack rock rings or TNT barrels; left-wall statue showed no damage feedback; embedded eye-faces in boss-room rocks survived direct blasts (likely invulnerable spawners, uncertain). y-offset >~70px misses (tears too).

ENEMIES: winged flies; knife-topped; fat pink/white/gray-faced enemies are tanky, enrage (red aura), chase, contact drains hearts fast. White-faced shelled enemies emerge from spiky pods/rock piles, leave damaging green clouds, and display a red tint plus blue HP bar when damaged/enraged; can be shot while emerging or once exposed. Gray wall/embedded faces shoot orbs/tears, seem endless, no coin. Small black spiders in dark stone room are fast, cluster, close-range deadly. Bomb-bugs slow, explode on contact, may be burst-immune. Green spiky clouds, poison clouds/puddles, orbs, and brazier flames damage. Green blob masses may be spawners; clearing them and all enemies did not visibly unlock exits. Blue splatter/gore burst marks enemy death. All-hollow hearts were observed while still controllable before, then the run ended after all hollow—meaning uncertain (near-death vs extra life); treat all-hollow as lethal on contact.

NAVIGATION (observed relationships): Tutorial room: top hatch ↔ rock room; bottom hatch ↔ brazier room; right-wall dark riveted door ↔ dark stone room. Rock room: left-wall keyhole/shop door opened without a key this run; shop sells bomb 5¢ and card 15¢; right-wall exit returns to rock room; bottom hatch ↔ tutorial; top hatch ↔ TNT room. Repeated upward presses at the rock room's top hatch with enemies alive did NOT transition; after the room was cleared and the player stood inside the top doorway alcove, an extra press finally led to the TNT room (clearing enemies and/or the alcove step may matter, uncertain). TNT room: TNT barrels (two isolated mid-room, cluster plus stone blocks along left wall), chests, bomb-bugs; top hatch ↔ boss room; bottom trapdoor ↔ rock room. Boss room: dark left-wall statue with red glow/eyes, central rock pile flanked by green spiky clouds, gilded sack with a fly, embedded eye-faces in right rocks, card on floor, bottom trapdoor ↔ TNT room; no other exit observed. Brazier room: four corner braziers (fire damages), central rock ring/chest, poison poop, bottom-center golden gate ↔ dark two-poop chamber (top gold door returns; its chest was/gone mimic-like), top alcove ↔ tutorial, left corridor bypasses the ring. Dark stone room: left-wall exit ↔ tutorial; top-wall red-barred chests, central spiked chest, two floor holes (probably pits), black spiders.

FAILED/CAUTION: attacking the left-wall statue repeatedly; attacking embedded eye-faces; assuming chests won't hurt; contact at low HP; lingering in green/poison clouds or brazier fire; shooting into nearby walls/rocks; assuming hatches/gates open without centered repeat presses (and possibly without clearing enemies); assuming coins/pickups collect on near-touch; assuming all poop gives loot; assuming Q card works. Item banners (TECH X; MATCH STICK—Tastes like burning; 2 OF SPADES—Item multiplier) can replace/hold the active item; after Match Stick, ring bursts were not visibly firing (unconfirmed). Firing while moving can drift aim off a stationary enemy; small y-offsets cause misses.

UNRESOLVED: how to progress past the boss/TNT/statue loop or what, if anything, damages the statue; whether the embedded eye-faces are invulnerable or high-HP; what the gilded item near the statue is; whether red-barred/spiked dark-room chests are openable and what the floor holes do; card effects (Q unclear; 2 of Spades 'Item multiplier' unknown); meaning of all-hollow hearts; how to reach the rock-ring chest (bomb failed; placement/method uncertain); whether shop's keyhole door truly requires no key; whether clearing a room (rather than the alcove position) is what allowed a hatch transition.
